tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build, dt = 60 s, damp_opt = 2 dampcoef = 0.003 zdamp = 5000 m, pert_coriolis = .true., use_theta_m = 1, hybrid_opt = 0; data/eqwefic/scm_dyn, the scm_ref namelist re-run with the instrumented binary) dumped by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork, branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 83347b2 (dyn_em/module_em.F rk_tendency, rk_step 1 of the step; module_esm_dump), merged with the same step's radiation subassembly dump and the wrfout eta grid by tools/merge_dumps.py into data/eqwefic/dumps/dyn_column/esm_dump_dyn_suite_<step>.json. The rebuilt binary reproduces the archived scm_ref radiation subassembly dumps bit for bit (all but the three B9 variables). The column is horizontally uniform (u, v identical in the two tile columns, ww = 0, all map factors 1, c1 = 1, c2 = 0). Expected tendencies are the dumped mass-coupled increments of the named routine divided by the coupling mass of their grid point (muu, muv, mut), i.e. the instantaneous decoupled rate at the time-level-n state; references are single precision, so tolerances follow the rel 1e-5 real32 convention, with absolute Linf bounds on whole profiles where values pass through zero. Routine: rk_rayleigh_damp (dyn_em/module_big_step_utilities_em.F:5836-6110). Measured esm-vs-Fortran residual over the four regimes (zero tolerance): Linf <= 1.4e-13 m/s^2 in du_dt (values <= 7.8e-8), <= 3.9e-14 in dv_dt, <= 2.7e-10 K/s in dtheta_m_dt (values <= 1.9e-4), <= 6.0e-13 m/s^2 in dw_dt (values <= 2.0e-6); damped layers 50-59 (z >= z_top - zdamp, ~7 km). At step 1 the only non-zero tendency is dtheta_m_dt: theta_m - theta_base = +0.050 K at the top because t_base is the DRY initial theta while the damped field is the moist theta (N64), so the damper cools the lid from the first step. Regime: step 1 (t = 1 min after 1999-10-22 19:00 UTC, the initial sounding: w = 0, u = u_base, v = v_base).
